structure.lattice: 12 tracks x 12 phases x 9 x 9 x 9
structure.note: Each of the 12 tracks carries its own full 12-phase progression; each phase is a full 9x9x9 cube on 3 axes. 12 tracks x 12 phases x 729 = 104,976.
structure.axes_role: The three axes are the MEASUREMENT DEPTH inside the lattice, not a twelve-fold system. They are the three 9s in 12 x 12 x 9 x 9 x 9. Every twelve-fold system in the platform (listed in twelve_fold_systems) is governed by this same lattice, so the rule 'every main 12 follows 12x12x9x9x9' is satisfied by all twelve of them. Raising the axes from 3 to 12 would make the lattice 12 x 12 x 9^12 = 40,669,853,253,264 -- 387,420,489 times larger than the confirmed 104,976 -- so the two statements cannot both hold. The confirmed figure is authoritative.
structure.per_member_rule: FRACTAL: every individual member of a twelve-fold system carries its OWN complete 12 x 12 x 9 x 9 x 9 lattice of 104,976 nodes -- not a share of one lattice. Each gate, each Olympian, each agent, each sign, each token, each NFT line, each article, each phase and each outer layer is a full world in itself.
structure.authority_i_note: i^2=-1 (imaginary unit): gate thresholds follow cos(n*phi*pi) damping in the complex plane
structure.axis_cubic: each axis spans A in [0.001, 9] contributing A^3 to the authority sum

nine_fold.note: Confirmed canon: every NINE-based system in the platform expands to a five-dimensional 9^5 lattice of 59,049 nodes, exactly as every TWELVE-based system expands to 12 x 12 x 9 x 9 x 9 = 104,976. The two lattices are parallel and independent: a twelve-fold system is never re-expressed as nine-fold, nor the reverse.
nine_fold.per_member_rule: FRACTAL: every individual member of a nine-fold system carries its OWN complete 9 x 9 x 9 x 9 x 9 lattice of 59,049 nodes.

economy.note: Single source of truth for the economic constants. total_supply x 0.51 must equal master_vault exactly. The Charter previously published 917,385,000,000 which yields 50.988%, not the stated 51%. The correct supply is 917,170,000,000 -- it satisfies the 51% lock exactly and encodes the platform identity 91717. Economy is DORMANT: no token is issued, transferable, or purchasable pending licensed legal counsel.
economy.tier_enforcement_note: OFF until payments activate. Paid tiers cannot be purchased while the checkout function is disabled, so enforcing paywalls now would lock every member out with no route forward. While false, [data-tier] content stays usable and shows a small 'TIER FEATURE' marker. Set true on the day the economy goes live to convert every marker on the platform into a real lock at once.

element_system.note: Tracks carry a PHYSICAL element (sign-derived). SOUL/SPACE/VOID are class-assigned; THE NINTH activates at Stage 9.
